# StockeZee

> > AI-powered stock screener and live market data platform for NSE/BSE trading with real-time technical analysis, FII/DII tracking, and intraday trading signals.

StockeZee is a comprehensive Indian stock market platform providing real-time screeners, technical analysis tools, and market intelligence for retail and intraday traders. The platform integrates NSE F&O data, global market indices, and institutional investor tracking with AI-powered predictive insights.

## Key Topics

- NSE Stock Screener
- Real-time Market Data
- Intraday Trading Signals
- Technical Analysis
- FII/DII Tracking
- Candlestick Patterns
- Opening Range Breakout (ORB)
- Nifty 50
- F&O Trading
- AI Stock Analysis
- Securities Lending & Borrowing (SLB)
- Insider Trading Data
- Global Indices
- VWAP
- Stock Fundamentals

## Core Screeners & Analysis Tools

- [NSE Stock Screener India | Free Fundamental & Technical Analysis | StockeZee](https://www.stockezee.com/stock-screener): Primary stock screener with price action, indicators, volume filters, and technical analysis
- [NSE Stock List 2026: Live Prices, Analysis & Screener | 2000+ Stocks | StockeZee](https://www.stockezee.com/stocks): Complete NSE stock list with live prices, analysis tools, and filtering by sector/market cap
- [AI-Based Stock Analysis for Indian Market – Predictive Insights | StockeZee](https://www.stockezee.com/stock-analysis-ai): AI-powered stock analysis with predictive insights, smart filters, and risk assessment
- [Candlestick Pattern Screener: Live NSE Stock Scanner with 16+ Patterns | StockeZee](https://www.stockezee.com/stock-screener/candlestick): Candlestick pattern scanner detecting 16+ patterns (Doji, Hammer, Engulfing) in real-time

## Intraday Trading Signals

- [Intraday Booster: Live FNO Breakout Stocks Scanner | NSE F&O Trading Signals 2026](https://www.stockezee.com/intraday-booster): Free FNO breakout scanner with ORB signals, strength scores, and real-time NSE F&O data
- [Opening Range Breakout (ORB) Stock Screener – NSE India | StockeZee](https://www.stockezee.com/stock-screener/opening-range-breakout): ORB stock screener with 15/30/45/60-min patterns and real-time breakout alerts
- [Top Gainers Today: NSE Stocks Showing Strong Performance | StockeZee](https://www.stockezee.com/stock-screener/top-gainers): Track top-gaining NSE stocks with performance analysis over multiple timeframes

## Market Indices & Global Markets

- [Indian Stock Market Today: Live Indices Updates & Performance | StockeZee](https://www.stockezee.com/indian-indices): Real-time Indian indices tracking: Sensex, Nifty 50, Bank Nifty performance updates
- [Nifty 50 Today: Live Stock Performance & Market Trends | StockeZee](https://www.stockezee.com/nifty-today): Interactive Nifty 50 tracker with live performance, percentage changes, and market trends
- [Global Stock Market Today: Live Indices Updates & Performance | StockeZee](https://www.stockezee.com/global-indices): Track major global indices: Dow Jones, NASDAQ, S&P 500, FTSE, Nikkei with live updates
- [Global Market Today | Global Market Indices and Currencies | StockeZee](https://www.stockezee.com/global-market-today): Real-time global indices, commodities, and currency market tracking dashboard

## Market Intelligence & News

- [StockeZee Markets | Live Stock Market News, Stocks & F&O Updates](https://www.stockezee.com/markets): Live market news, stock focus, F&O trends, sector movement, and FII/DII tracking

## Institutional & Insider Activity

- [FII DII Data Today (18 Mar 2026): NSE Daily FII Activity, Participant Wise OI & Derivative Summary | StockeZee](https://www.stockezee.com/fii-dii-data): Daily FII/DII activity tracker with participant-wise OI and derivatives data for Nifty
- [FII Buying Stocks Today: Foreign Institutional Investors Buying Activity | StockeZee](https://www.stockezee.com/fii-buying): Monitor FII buying activity and foreign institutional investor inflows in real-time
- [NSE Insider Trading Data: Track Insider Buys & Sells | StockeZee](https://www.stockezee.com/nse-insider-trading): Real-time NSE insider trading data tracking promoter and director buy/sell activities
- [NSE SLB Data Today: Securities Lending & Borrowing Live Rates 2026 | StockeZee](https://www.stockezee.com/securities-lending-and-borrowing): Live NSE SLB data with lending fees, borrowing rates, and eligible stocks tracking
